verdict.rationale: The axis applies: GrowthBook is a SaaS and open-source platform with AI features (an AI Visual Editor and an MCP integration), so a buyer could reasonably ask about an AI-training opt-out. The pack contains no policy, setting or contractual commitment covering use of customer data for model training. Self-hosting and the statement that targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook are adjacent data-locality facts, not a documented control that prevents AI training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
